description: This PHP class defines a controller named RequestPasswordController for handling password reset requests in the OrangeHRM system. It manages rendering of the password reset request page, including CSRF token handling and email configuration checks.

classes.name: RequestPasswordController
classes.description: Controller for handling password reset requests, responsible for preparing the view for password request with CSRF token and email configuration checks.

methods.name: getEmailService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the EmailService instance used to check email configuration.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view component for the password reset page. Checks email configuration and adds CSRF token if configured.
